text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: Morning, Ines! I see you're full of energy as usual.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: Actually, I've got a favor to ask you.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: I want to put you on a new task. You always do a great job of things, so I'm leaving this one in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Welcome back, Ines. Hey, you look happy. Something good happen?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Well, I got given a really important task today.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So I'm really happy my manager thinks of me as a reliable worker. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Congrats! I mean, you're always doing your very best, so it's no wonder everyone values you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Teehee. You're going to make me blush saying that stuff right to my face.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: All righty! Time to prove that my manager was right to trust me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After being assigned a difficult job, Ines Fujin comes away having learned a few new things.
